info.title: Infiora API
info.description: Authoritative REST API for the Infiora hotel guest platform.

password.description: At least one number and one letter

post.description: An email will be sent to reset password.

password.description: At least one number and one letter

post.description: An email will be sent to verify email.

post.summary: Create a Stripe PaymentIntent for an online booking
post.description: Server calculates the booking total from the catalog item, party size, and addons. Returns a Stripe client secret for the guest to complete payment. Pass the returned paymentIntentId and checkoutId when calling POST /hotels/{hotelId}/bookings with payment='online'.
Guest creates a booking for a hotel item. Public endpoint, no authentication required.

startTime.description: ISO 8601 date-time for the booking start

get.summary: List all bookings for a hotel
get.description: Hotel owner lists all bookings. Requires authentication and hotel owner role.

post.summary: Join the waitlist for a fully-booked slot
post.description: Guest joins the waitlist for a hotel item slot. Public endpoint, no authentication required.

slotStartTime.description: ISO 8601 date-time for the desired slot

get.summary: Get guest's own bookings for a room
get.description: Guest fetches their own bookings by room. Public endpoint, no authentication required.

200.description: List of bookings for the guest room

get.summary: Get booking settings for a hotel
get.description: Retrieve the booking configuration for a hotel. Requires authentication.

patch.summary: Update booking settings for a hotel
patch.description: Update the booking configuration for a hotel. Requires authentication and hotel owner role.

patch.summary: Update a booking's status or staff notes
patch.description: Staff or hotel owner updates a booking. Requires authentication and hotel owner role.
Hotel owner cancels a specific booking. Requires authentication and hotel owner role.
Guest cancels a booking using a secure token. Public endpoint, no authentication required.

token.description: Secure cancellation token sent to the guest

patch.summary: Guest cancels their own booking (alternate path)
patch.description: Alternate path for guest booking cancellation using a secure token. Public endpoint, no authentication required.

token.description: Secure cancellation token sent to the guest

get.summary: List bookable resources for a hotel
get.description: Returns all bookable resources configured for the hotel. Requires authentication and hotel owner role.

post.description: Creates a new bookable resource for the hotel. Requires authentication and hotel owner role.

patch.description: Updates an existing bookable resource. Requires authentication and hotel owner role.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a bookable resource. Requires authentication and hotel owner role.

get.summary: List blackout dates for a hotel
get.description: Returns all blackout dates during which bookings are disabled. Requires authentication and hotel owner role.

post.description: Adds a blackout date range during which no bookings can be made. Requires authentication and hotel owner role.

schema.description: Blackout date definition (startDate, endDate, reason, etc.)

delete.description: Removes a blackout date entry. Requires authentication and hotel owner role.

get.description: Returns available booking timeslots for a hotel item. Public endpoint, no authentication required.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Bookable item MongoDB ObjectId to filter timeslots

patch.description: Marks a specific timeslot as blocked, preventing new bookings. Requires authentication and hotel owner role.
Removes the block from a timeslot, allowing new bookings. Requires authentication and hotel owner role.

get.description: Returns categories, items, settings and active promotions for a room. Used by the guest ordering page on load.

200.description: Catalog object with categories, items and settings

post.description: Place a new order for a room. Validates the reservation code server-side.

itemId.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the catalog item

post.summary: Create a Stripe PaymentIntent for guest checkout
post.description: Creates a Stripe PaymentIntent for the guest to complete payment online.

get.description: Returns the current status of an order for the guest tracker page.

post.description: Submit a star rating for a completed order.

post.summary: Send order status link to guest email
post.description: Sends a link to the guest's email so they can track their order status.

get.summary: Get all guest orders and bookings by status token
get.description: Retrieves all orders, bookings and requests associated with a guest status token.

200.description: Guest status object with orders and bookings

post.summary: Get guest status by token in request body
post.description: Same as GET /guest-status but accepts the token in the request body instead of a query parameter.

200.description: Guest status object with orders and bookings

post.summary: Validate a discount code before checkout
post.description: Validates a discount code against a hotel's active codes and returns the discount details.

totalAmount.description: Optional order total for minimum-spend validation

get.description: Returns a paginated and filtered list of orders for a hotel.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Filter orders up to this date

get.description: Returns order analytics and statistics for a hotel.
Returns the order settings for a hotel.

patch.description: Updates the order settings for a hotel.

schema.description: Partial order settings object to update

get.description: Returns all order categories for a hotel's catalog.

post.description: Creates a new order category for a hotel's catalog.

get.description: Returns all catalog items for a hotel.

post.description: Creates a new catalog item for a hotel. Supports image upload via multipart/form-data.
Accepts an order and sets the estimated time of arrival.
Advances the order through its status lifecycle (e.g. Processing -> On the way -> Completed).
Cancels an order, optionally providing a reason.

get.description: Returns all discount codes for a hotel.

post.description: Creates a new discount code for a hotel.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of rooms. Authentication is optional — authenticated hotel owners see their own rooms; unauthenticated callers need to supply a hotel ID.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Full-text search term applied to room name/suffix/prefix

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort field and order, format: field:asc|desc

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rooms to return per page

post.description: Bulk-creates one or more rooms for a hotel. The authenticated user must own the hotel.

suffix.description: Optional suffix appended to each room label

prefix.description: Optional prefix prepended to each room label

start.description: Starting number for the room sequence

example.message: "quantity" must be less than or equal to 100

get.description: Returns a CSV file containing all rooms for the specified hotel. The authenticated user must own the hotel.

parameters.name: hotel
parameters.description: Hotel ObjectId whose rooms to export

400.description: Bad request — hotel query param missing or invalid

post.description: Public endpoint (rate-limited to 15 requests per 15 minutes per IP) that allows guests to submit a satisfaction rating and optional message for a room.

surveyAnswers.description: Optional key-value map of survey question IDs to answers

example.message: "rating" must be less than or equal to 10

429.description: Too many requests — rate limit exceeded

example.message: Too many requests, please try again later

get.description: Returns a paginated list of guest feedback entries. The authenticated user must own the hotel.

parameters.name: hotel
parameters.description: Hotel ObjectId to filter feedback by

parameters.name: room
parameters.description: Optional room ObjectId to narrow results to a single room

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Filter feedback submitted on or after this date (ISO 8601)

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Filter feedback submitted on or before this date (ISO 8601)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term applied to feedback message or email

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of feedback entries per page

get.description: Returns the full details of a single room. Authentication is optional. An optional lang query parameter can be used to request translated content.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: BCP-47 language code for translated room content (e.g. de, hr, fr)

patch.description: Updates room settings and optionally replaces the popup or background image. The authenticated user must be the room owner. Request body is multipart/form-data to support image uploads.

popup[image].description: Replacement image for the room popup (max 1 file)

background[image].description: Replacement image for the room background (max 1 file)

delete.description: Permanently deletes a room and all its associated data. The authenticated user must be the room owner.

post.description: Public, rate-limited endpoint (120 requests per 15 minutes per IP) used by the guest app to record a view or tap interaction on a room. Returns an activityId that can be used to update the session later.

visitorId.description: Unique anonymous identifier for the guest session (UUID)

language.description: Guest browser/app language (BCP-47 code or full name)

button.description: Identifier of the button that was tapped (for tap actions)

buttonTitle.description: Human-readable label of the tapped button

activityId.description: ObjectId of the created activity, used for subsequent time-spent updates

429.description: Too many requests — rate limit exceeded

example.message: Too many requests, please try again later

post.description: Public endpoint used by the guest app to update an existing activity record with time-spent and engagement data once the guest leaves or the session ends.

parameters.name: activityId
parameters.description: Activity ObjectId returned from the create activity endpoint

time.description: Total time the guest spent on the room page, in seconds

engaged.description: Whether the guest was considered engaged (scrolled, tapped, etc.)

language.description: Guest browser/app language at session end (BCP-47 code or full name)

429.description: Too many requests — rate limit exceeded

example.message: Too many requests, please try again later

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users. Requires getUsers permission.

post.description: Creates a new user. Requires manageUsers permission.

patch.description: Updates the authenticated user's own account details. Requires ownership.

get.description: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user.
Returns aggregated insights about users. Requires manageUsers permission.
Returns a single user by ID. Requires getUsers permission.

patch.description: Updates a user's details by ID. Requires manageUsers permission.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a user by ID. Requires manageUsers permission.
